meta.title: LTNHoot — Quiz & events · Les Toiles Noires
meta.description: An interactive quiz to bring guests together, play on phones and share the excitement of the leaderboard. Discover LTNHoot and request an event quote.

hero.description: One screen, your phones, and everyone’s in the game. The interactive quiz from Les Toiles Noires brings fresh energy to your evenings.

demo.label: Interactive demo
demo.question: What is the capital of Réunion?
demo.ready: One question, four options. Which will you choose?
demo.incorrect: It was Saint-Denis. You’ll get the next one!
demo.caption: Sample question. This demo does not join a game or record any scores.

how.title: Everyone can join the game.
how.intro: Easy to pick up, so the focus stays on what matters: having fun together.

join.title: Scan. You’re in.
join.text: Players scan the QR code or enter the game code in their browser. Pick a name, and you’re ready.

play.title: Your phone becomes a buzzer.
play.text: Questions appear on the big screen. Everyone answers on their phone, at their own pace or against the clock, depending on the mode.

win.title: Let the points do the talking.
win.text: Answers are revealed and the leaderboard changes. Quiz after quiz, evening scores add up to the final standings.

formats.title: Change the question. Keep the energy.
formats.intro: Nine formats to vary the challenge, surprise players and make your quiz your own.
formats.note: Illustrative preview. Create your questions in the app.

mcq.name: Multiple choice
mcq.description: Several options, one answer to find. The classic that brings everyone together.

true_false.name: True or false
true_false.description: Two options to decide. Ideal for challenging common assumptions.

open.name: Open answer
open.description: Players type their answer. It’s up to them to find the right word.

image_sequence.name: Progressive images
image_sequence.description: Images are revealed as the question unfolds. Each clue gets you closer to the answer.

date.name: Find the date
date.description: An event, a date. Put your memory to the test.

slider.name: Estimation
slider.description: Move the slider to make your estimate. Aim for the right value.

puzzle.name: Puzzle
puzzle.description: Put the pieces back in place to complete the image.

drop_pin.name: Pin on an image
drop_pin.description: Place your pin on an image. Find the right spot on a map or another visual.

grid.name: Grid
grid.description: Find the right cell in a grid. Let your observation skills take over.

scores.title: An evening-wide leaderboard.
scores.text: Start the evening, play several quizzes, then wrap it up. Players’ points are saved and added together to reveal the winners.

remote.title: Hosting at your fingertips.
remote.text: The host controls the game with the remote on their phone, staying close to the players.

mobile.title: No installation for players.
mobile.text: A phone browser is enough to join. No app download to ask of your guests.

paths.title: Your evening. Your way to play.
paths.intro: Let us host the event, or take control of the app yourself.

event.title: Shall we make an evening of it?
event.text: A business event, a bar night, time with friends: tell us your idea and let’s plan an event with Les Toiles Noires.
event.one: A proposal based on your event
event.note: Quoted individually. Tell us about your project so we can confirm what’s possible and when.

app.title: You’re in control.
app.text: Already have organiser access? Prepare quizzes and host games. The app is also open source if you want to install it yourself.
app.join: Join a game with a code
app.note: The organiser area requires administrator access. Self-hosting requires hosting and technical configuration.

quote.title: What if your next evening started here?
quote.text: Tell us about the occasion, the place and the guests. We can discuss your plans and put together a suitable quote.

form.name: Full name
form.notice: This form prepares an email in your email app. You can review and send it yourself; nothing is sent automatically.
form.subject: Quote request — LTNHoot event
form.prepared: Your message is prepared. If your email app does not open, write to us directly at the address below.

app.question: Do players need to download an app?
app.answer: No. Players join in their phone browser by scanning a QR code or entering the game code.

equipment.question: What equipment do we need?
equipment.answer: Each player needs a phone with a browser. Questions need a large screen and network access to the app. The organiser prepares and controls the game from the organiser area.

scores.question: Can points carry over across quizzes?
scores.answer: Yes. The organiser starts an evening before the quizzes. Players’ scores are saved and added together. Ending the evening reveals the overall leaderboard and the winner or joint winners.

quote.question: How do I send my quote request?
quote.answer: Complete the form and choose “Open my email app”. A draft opens in your email app; review and send it. You can also write directly to contact@lestoilesnoires.re.

admin.question: Can anyone access the organiser area?
admin.answer: It requires existing administrator access; there is no open signup. To run your own instance, the open-source code and installation instructions are available on GitHub.

footer.by: An experience by Les Toiles Noires.
